description: Builds an automation from a description, as the Describe it chat in Cosend does. action start opens a chat on one WhatsApp number (connection_id), optionally on an existing automation of that number (automation_id), and answers with the chat. action reply (id of the chat, message) sends the owner’s words and waits for the answer: what was built or changed in plain words, its Test result, and what needs connecting, with an outcome of built, changed, cannot, question or stopped. What it builds is switched off; switching on is a separate, confirmed step. Starter plan and above. Owners and admins.

action.description: start opens a new authoring chat on a number. reply sends the owner’s next message in a chat and returns the answer.

automation_id.description: An automation on that number for the conversation to start on, to fix or improve it. Refused when another conversation already holds it (that conversation’s id is named; open it instead), and for an automation made from a recipe, the AI receptionist included.

connection_id.description: The WhatsApp number (connection id) the conversation builds and changes automations for. It touches no other number’s.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

message.description: What the owner needs, or their answer to a question, in their own words.

name: describe_automation
title: Describe an automation in words
